property_summary: For any caller and amount, when the contract owner calls sendTo with a receiver whose fallback reverts, the reference contract always reverts the send (call fails), but the mutant that uses unchecked send may return success (not revert), allowing the call to complete despite the transfer failing.
change_summary: Change the transfer call to send(...) and drop the require on its result so the function no longer reverts when the transfer fails.
